resources.name: Eventual — Microservices Architecture
resources.description:
REST API collection for the Eventual Microservices architecture running on port 8080.

--- GETTING STARTED ---
1. Create 5 databases:
   psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE eventual_users;'
   psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE eventual_events;'
   psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE eventual_notifications;'
   psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE eventual_vendors;'
   psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE eventual_support;'
2. Load schemas:
   psql -U postgres -d eventual_users         -f selected/eventual.database/user-service.sql
   psql -U postgres -d eventual_events        -f selected/eventual.database/event-service.sql
   psql -U postgres -d eventual_notifications -f selected/eventual.database/notification-service.sql
   psql -U postgres -d eventual_vendors       -f selected/eventual.database/vendor-service.sql
   psql -U postgres -d eventual_support       -f selected/eventual.database/support-service.sql
3. Run the app: cd selected && docker compose up --build
4. Register via POST /api/users/register
5. Login via POST /api/users/login — copy the 'token' from the response
6. Open Manage Environments → paste token into the 'token' variable

--- ROLES ---
ORGANIZER  — can create/update events, groups, vendors
PARTICIPANT — can RSVP, join groups, post reviews
ADMIN       — cannot register via API; set directly in DB:
  UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN' WHERE email = 'admin@example.com';

User registration, login, and profile management.
Public: /register and /login — all others require Bearer token.

resources.name: 📅 Events

resources.name: 👥 Groups
resources.description: Group management and join request workflow.

resources.name: 🎟️ RSVPs
resources.description: RSVP to events and manage attendance.

resources.name: 🔍 Search

resources.name: ⭐ Recommendations
resources.description: AI-powered event and group recommendations based on user profile.

resources.name: 🔔 Notifications
resources.description: View and manage in-app notifications.

resources.description: Vendor management, reviews, and linking vendors to events.

resources.name: Register Organizer
resources.description:
Register as an ORGANIZER — can create events, groups, and vendors.
Valid roles: ORGANIZER, PARTICIPANT
Do NOT set Content-Type manually — Insomnia sets it with the multipart boundary automatically.

resources.name: Register Participant
resources.description: Register as a PARTICIPANT — can RSVP to events, join groups, and post vendor reviews.

resources.name: Register Admin (then promote in DB)
resources.description:
ADMIN is not a registerable role (UserRole enum only has ORGANIZER and PARTICIPANT).
Step 1: Register as ORGANIZER using this request.
Step 2: Promote to ADMIN directly in PostgreSQL:
  UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN' WHERE email = 'admin@example.com';
Step 3: Login again to get a fresh JWT with the ADMIN role.

resources.name: Login
resources.description:
Returns: { token, email, role }
Copy the 'token' value and paste it into the Base Environment 'token' variable.

resources.name: Login (Admin)
resources.description: Login after promoting the user to ADMIN in the DB. The returned token will carry the ADMIN role.

resources.name: Update User Profile
resources.description: Update profile for the given email. A user can only update their own profile.

params.name: aboutMe
params.value: Passionate event organizer and tech lover.

resources.name: Create Event (PUBLIC)
resources.description:
Create a public event. Requires ORGANIZER role.
Fields are sent as multipart form fields (camelCase — @ModelAttribute binding, not JSON).
Valid eventType values: PUBLIC, GROUP

params.name: description
params.value: A networking event for Dallas tech enthusiasts.

resources.name: Create Event (GROUP)
resources.description:
Create a group-scoped event. Requires ORGANIZER role.
groupId must reference an existing group.

params.name: description
params.value: Exclusive hands-on photography workshop for group members.

resources.name: Get Event by ID
resources.description: Fetch full event details including RSVP counts. Requires authentication.

resources.name: Update Event
resources.description: Update an existing event. Requires ORGANIZER role.

params.name: description
params.value: Updated: Join us for talks, demos, and networking.

params.name: location
params.value: Omni Dallas Hotel, 555 S Lamar, Dallas TX

resources.name: Delete Event
resources.description: Delete an event. Requires ORGANIZER role. Returns 204 No Content. Sends cancellation notifications to all RSVPs.

resources.name: Create Group (Public)
resources.description:
Create a public group. Requires ORGANIZER role.
is_public=true: anyone can join immediately.
is_public=false: joining creates a pending request needing approval.

resources.name: Create Group (Private)
resources.description: Create a private group — membership requires organizer approval. Requires ORGANIZER role.

resources.name: Update Group
resources.description: Update group details. Requires ORGANIZER role.

resources.name: Join Group
resources.description:
Join a group.
Public group → 200 OK, immediately added as member.
Private group → 202 Accepted, creates a pending join request.

resources.name: Get Pending Join Requests
resources.description: List pending membership requests for a group. Requires ORGANIZER role.

resources.name: Approve Join Request
resources.description: Approve a pending join request. Requires ORGANIZER role. Adds the requester to group members and sends approval notification.

resources.name: Reject Join Request
resources.description: Reject a pending join request. Requires ORGANIZER role. Sends rejection notification to requester.

resources.name: RSVP to Event
resources.description:
RSVP to an event.
Returns status GOING (if capacity allows) or WAITLISTED.
Sends notification to the organizer.

resources.name: Cancel RSVP
resources.description:
Cancel an existing RSVP.
Returns 200 OK with the updated Rsvp object (status = CANCELLED).
The first WAITLISTED attendee is automatically promoted to GOING.

resources.name: Get All RSVPs for Event
resources.description: List all RSVPs (GOING and WAITLISTED) for an event. Requires ORGANIZER role.

resources.name: Search Events
resources.description:
Full-text search across event titles and descriptions via Elasticsearch.
All query params are optional — omit any to broaden the search.
Requires authentication (all endpoints except /register and /login need a token).

resources.name: Search Groups
resources.description: Full-text search across group names and descriptions. Requires authentication.

resources.name: Recommended Events
resources.description: AI-powered event recommendations based on the authenticated user's category preferences and RSVP history.

resources.name: Recommended Groups
resources.description: AI-powered group recommendations based on the authenticated user's profile and interests.

resources.name: Get Notifications
resources.description: Get paginated notifications for the authenticated user, newest first.

resources.name: Get Unread Count

resources.name: Mark Notification as Read

resources.name: Mark All as Read

resources.name: Delete Notification
resources.description: Delete a notification. Returns 204 No Content.

  "contact_email": "hello@deliciouscatering.com",
  "contact_phone": "+1-214-555-0101",
  "description": "Full-service catering for corporate and private events. Farm-to-table menus.",
  "website": "https://deliciouscatering.com",
  "is_preferred": true
}

resources.name: Get All Categories

resources.name: Trigger Reindex
resources.description:
Start a full Elasticsearch reindex. Reads all events and groups from PostgreSQL, generates Ollama vector embeddings, and writes documents to the search index.
Returns 202 Accepted immediately — the job runs in the background.
Returns 409 Conflict if a reindex is already in progress.
Requires authentication.

resources.name: Get Reindex Status
resources.description:
Poll the status of the current or most recent reindex job.
Response fields: state (IDLE | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED), eventsIndexed, groupsIndexed, eventsFailed, groupsFailed, totalEvents, totalGroups, startedAt, completedAt, error.
